commit.message:
Move the doc separators around

When we are trying to extract different resources from the same YAML,
sometimes we got nil document because the doc separators (`---`) are
misplaced. This PR fixes it so that we always have the following
structure:

```
(some resources here ...)
{% if condition %}
---
apiVersion:
...
{% endif %}
```

Where the `---` is the first line starting a new document.

commit.message:
Upgrade API version for Deployment

The Deployment resource has graduated to v1 a few releases back. The
"apps/v1beta1" API group is no longer served starting 1.18. We'd better
stop using the "extensions/v1beta1" API group for them.
